action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
USN-9176-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Ruby. This update provides the
corresponding updates for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu
20.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 Stephan Lipp discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled converting the case
 of certain strings. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
 denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5)

 Owais Lone discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled compiling certain
 large regular expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
 cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w)

 Stephan Lipp discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled converting certain
 regular expressions to strings. An attacker could possibly use this issue
 to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (GHSA-7whj-
 cfh7-xgm4)

 Stephan Lipp discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled memory when parsing
 certain regular expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
 cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x)

 It was discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled converting the case of
 certain large strings. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
 a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px)

 It was discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled certain case-insensitive
 regular expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
 denial of service or obtain sensitive information. (GHSA-pvgc-g7gj-pv6h)

 Stephan Lipp discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled certain case-
 insensitive regular expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue
 to cause a denial of service or obtain sensitive information. (GHSA-
 wpqw-5qxg-m68r)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Ruby.
title: Ruby vulnerabilities
